_about: Tests that fail today because of a known defect. Listed + failed = reported as known-failing. Listed + passed = the runner FAILS until the entry is removed (the fix must remove its own marker). Unlisted + failed = the runner FAILS. Keys are <page>#<test id>; defects are described in KNOWN-ISSUES.md.
